reinforcement.actor_critic_allocation.runtime_rule: Use one risky weight with a cash complement and calculate log gross portfolio return.
Fit a linear value function and update the actor with a one-step advantage.
Sample a Gaussian latent action and map the selected risky weight into a bounded position.

reinforcement.double_q_market_making.runtime_rule: Initialize two action-value tables with the declared learning and discount factors.
Select one table for each update, choose the next action in it and evaluate with the other table.
Choose the behavior action from the combined values of both learned tables.

rule.channel_breakout.runtime_rule: Compare the latest close with completed-window extrema and the declared one-percent band.
Maintain the active position through its ten-session hold and ignore intervening entry signals.

supervised.cross_sectional_rank.runtime_rule: Fit the fixed elastic-net objective by a soft-threshold coordinate update.
Rank a complete daily panel of forecasts and target the highest and lowest symbols.

reinforcement.execution_value_learning.runtime_rule: Build a finite-horizon state from remaining time, remaining inventory and public pressure.
Sweep the horizon backward and update each state-action cost with observed immediate cost and continuation.
At the terminal decision, force the outstanding quantity into the available action set.

supervised.gaussian_nb_direction.runtime_rule: Fit one Gaussian Naive Bayes component with per-class priors, feature means and variances.
Combine each class prior and conditional feature density in log space to score direction.

rule.moving_average_crossover.runtime_rule: Calculate short and long arithmetic means from completed daily closing prices.
Choose long, short or flat target inventory from the mean gap and declared band.

rule.microprice_toy.runtime_rule: Compute best-bid-size weighted ask plus best-ask-size weighted bid, then compare with last trade price.

rule.pairs_distance.runtime_rule: Select the formation pair minimizing squared distance between normalized closing-price paths.
Open at a two-standard-deviation divergence and close when the normalized spread crosses zero.
Keep the declared formation and subsequent trading windows disjoint in event time.

supervised.queue_imbalance.runtime_rule: Compute best-bid-size minus best-ask-size divided by their sum on each L1 event.
Fit two logistic coefficients and map the observed imbalance to a next-up probability.

supervised.random_forest_operations.runtime_rule: Train trees on bootstrap samples with node-level feature subsampling, then take a majority vote.
Construct the three operation labels from declared gain, loss and duration rules.
Limit each training row to labels known before the held-out evaluation interval.

rule.reservation_quote.runtime_rule: Calculate a horizon-adjusted reservation price from midpoint, inventory and variance.
Calculate both quote prices from the paper spread approximation and submit price-bounded limits.

supervised.ridge_three_day_price.runtime_rule: Flatten three completed OHLCV days into one feature row and attach a later available target.
Solve a linear squared-error model with a declared L2 penalty and persist its coefficients.

reinforcement.risk_averse_bandit.runtime_rule: Update the selected arm's one-dimensional normal-gamma posterior from realized rewards.
Sample precision and mean for each arm, then subtract the declared variance-risk penalty.
Observe the next price interval before updating only the arm actually held during that interval.

reinforcement.sarsa_inventory.runtime_rule: Update the current action value using the actual next behavior action, not a greedy maximum.
Discretize inventory and declared market observations into the learner's runtime state.
